name: Kurashiki Yae
source:
An ordinary widow She has been a friend of Yuka's for a long time and is also acquainted with Takeshi.

Like Yuka, she has a mild-mannered personality. In fact, she is too quiet. Her face, which always looks dissatisfied, has a shadow over it.

She is usually in a lonely mood, To Takeshi she appears like a "mysterious widow".

When the "Search for Maman" started, Takeshi had to move to the company dormitory where Yae lived. Takeshi did not show strong opposition to it, he gets to see Yae and Karin, whom he has longed to see.

[From [url=http://ps-web.net/tryset/maman/photo/yae.htmll]official site[/url]]
